words.definition: The study of the fundamental nature of knowledge, reality, and existence.
words.sentence1: His personal philosophy was to treat every challenge as an opportunity to learn. (His personal philosophy was to treat every challenge as an opportunity to learn.)
words.sentence2: Ancient Greek philosophy laid the groundwork for modern scientific inquiry. (Ancient Greek philosophy laid the groundwork for modern scientific inquiry.)

words.definition: The quality of having experience, knowledge, and good judgment.
words.sentence1: La sabiduria de los mayores debe ser respetada siempre. (The wisdom of the elders must always be respected.)
words.sentence2: Busco la sabiduria en los libros antiguos y en la vida diaria. (I seek wisdom in ancient books and in daily life.)

words.sentence1: La sagesse vient avec l'experience et le temps. (Wisdom comes with experience and time.)
words.sentence2: Il a repondu avec une grande sagesse a cette question difficile. (He answered with great wisdom to that difficult question.)

words.definition: The quality of having experience, knowledge, and good judgment; the soundness of an action or decision.
words.sentence1: Alte sprichwoerter enthalten oft viel Weisheit. (Old proverbs often contain a lot of wisdom.)
words.sentence2: Die Suche nach Weisheit ist eine lebenslange Aufgabe. (The search for wisdom is a lifelong task.)

words.sentence1: Kare wa konnan o norikoeru tame no chie o motte iru. (He possesses the wisdom to overcome difficulties.)
words.sentence2: Senjin no chie wa ima mo ikite iru. (The wisdom of our ancestors is still alive today.)

words.sentence1: La sapienza popolare si tramanda di generazione in generazione. (Popular wisdom is handed down from generation to generation.)
words.sentence2: Ha affrontato il problema con grande sapienza e calma. (He faced the problem with great wisdom and calm.)

words.sentence1: Lishi gei women liuxiaole bujin de zhihui. (History has left us with endless wisdom.)
words.sentence2: Wo men xuyao zhihui lai jiejue zhege fuza de wenti. (We need wisdom to solve this complex problem.)

words.sentence1: Gyeheum eun saram ege jiheye eul julsu isseumnida. (Experience can give a person wisdom.)
words.sentence2: Urineun seonjodeului jiheye eul baewoya hamnida. (We must learn the wisdom of our ancestors.)

words.sentence1: Neak prachanh mean phaem chreun knong kar kit. (Wise people have much wisdom in their thinking.)
words.sentence2: Kar saul chea mnus sa-at trov kar phaem. (Living a clean life requires wisdom.)

words.definition: Wisdom, the quality of having experience and good judgment.
words.sentence1: Ouer lede van die gemeenskap bring groot wysheid. (Older members of the community bring great wisdom.)
words.sentence2: Dit verg wysheid om die regte besluit te neem. (It takes wisdom to make the right decision.)
